mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO rating (order_id, customer_id, ratee_id, rating_type, rating_value, comment, rating_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{rating.orderId}, #{rating.customerId}, #{rating.rateeId}, #{rating.ratingType}, #{rating.ratingValue}, #{rating.comment}, #{rating.ratingTime}, #{rating.createTime}, #{rating.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS customerName, r.rating_value AS ratingValue, r.comment AS comment, r.rating_time AS ratingTime FROM rating r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.rating_type = 'SERVICE' AND r.ratee_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY r.rating_time DESC

SELECT mo.order_number AS orderNumber, s_order.service_name AS orderServiceName, r.rating_type AS ratedEntityType, CASE WHEN r.rating_type = 'DRIVER' THEN d.name WHEN r.rating_type = 'MOVER' THEN m.name WHEN r.rating_type = 'SERVICE' THEN s_ratee.service_name ELSE '未知对象' END AS ratedEntityName, r.rating_value AS ratingValue, r.comment AS comment, r.rating_time AS ratingTime FROM rating r JOIN moving_order mo ON r.order_id = mo.id JOIN service s_order ON mo.service_id = s_order.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON r.rating_type = 'DRIVER' AND r.ratee_id = d.id LEFT JOIN mover m ON r.rating_type = 'MOVER' AND r.ratee_id = m.id LEFT JOIN service s_ratee ON r.rating_type = 'SERVICE' AND r.ratee_id = s_ratee.id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY r.rating_time DESC
